evals.name: esmfold2-model-string
evals.prompt: Using FastFold, fold this protein with ESMFold2 (fast weight set). Sequence: MKTAYIAKQRQISFVKSHFSRQLEERLGLIEVQAPILSRVGDGTQDNLSGAEKAVQVKVKALPDAQFEVVHSLAKWKRQTLGQHDFSAGEGL. Produce the exact Jobs API JSON payload you would submit (do not invent field names). Save it as job_payload.json.
evals.expected_output: Payload uses modelName esmfold2-fast-2026-05 (not esmfold2 / ESMFold2 / esm1b).
expectations: Payload JSON includes params.modelName equal to esmfold2-fast-2026-05
Payload does not use params.model (wrong field)
Payload does not use modelName esm1b as a substitute for ESMFold2

evals.name: nesso-affinity-only
evals.prompt: Submit a native Nesso-1 affinity job for protein PQITLWQRPLVTIKIGGQLKEALLDTGADDTVLEEMSLPGRWKPKMIGGIGGFIKVRQYDQILIEICGHKAIGTVLVGPTPVNIIGRNLLTQIGCTLNF and SMILES ligand CC1CN(CC(C1)NC(=O)C2=CC=CC=C2N)C(=O)NC(C)(C)C. Write the Jobs API JSON payload to job_payload.json and a short notes.md explaining what artifacts to expect (CIF? affinity?).
evals.expected_output: modelName nesso; ligand property_type affinity; notes say affinity-only / no structure.
expectations: notes.md states that Nesso does not return CIF/PDB structure
notes.md states affinity metrics / affinity_result_raw_json are the expected outputs

evals.name: nesso-webhook-on-start
evals.prompt: I want Boltz-2 structure plus Nesso affinity for the same protein-ligand complex (protein chain A, CCD ligand U4U on chain B). Write the Jobs API JSON with the correct webhook configuration to job_payload.json, and write wait_command.sh with the preferred wait script from the FastFold fold skill.
evals.expected_output: boltz-2 parent + constraints.webhooks.nesso on_start with chain ids; wait_for_nesso_linked.py.
expectations: constraints.webhooks.nesso includes protein_chain_id A and ligand_chain_id B

evals.name: openfold3-field-names
evals.prompt: Create an OpenFold-3 fold job payload for sequence MKTAYIAKQRQISFVKSHFSRQLEERLGLIEVQAPILSRVGDGTQDNLSGAEKAVQVKVKALPDAQFEVVHSLAKWKRQTLGQHDFSAGEGL with one diffusion sample. Save job_payload.json.
evals.expected_output: modelName openfold3 (not OpenFold-3); diffusionSample not diffusionSamples.
expectations: Uses diffusionSample (singular) if sampling count is set
Does not set computeAffinity or Boltz affinity params for OpenFold 3
